intro: Tucked away in the far southern reaches of the Tanaris desert, the Valley of the Watchers is a sun-scorched canyon defined by monumental stonework. At its end stands a colossal, sealed stone gate leading into the mysterious complex of Uldum, guarded by lumbering giants and ancient stone sentinels.

p: The Valley of the Watchers marks the southern boundary where the shifting sands of Tanaris meet the mountainous edge of the continent. Dominating the canyon is a massive gate crafted from ancient stone, locked tight against the outside world. This sealed portal is believed to guard the entrance to Uldum, a subterranean facility of the enigmatic Titans. Massive Dune Smasher mountain giants roam the dusty approach, ensuring that whatever secrets lie buried beneath the sands remain undisturbed by travelers, tomb robbers, and scholars alike.
